en: ...Huh? Did the Captain pick up\nsomething strange again?
Whoa, what a gaudy ring... and\nthat stone looks like it'd break\neasily.
Heh, let me see. This... yeah, it\ndefinitely looks like it would go\n"crack" in a heartbeat...
Look for the owner.
Sell it.
Try to break it.
The owner might be worried,\nfor sure. But how would we\neven find them...?
Maybe there's a name written\non it? Come on, let me see!

No, no, no! I said no! If you
don't know the value of things
like this, you'll just get ripped
off.
For now, we have to start by\nfiguring out what material this\nis...
That's our Captain for you!\nLOCK and load! Now that's wild!

Hold it right there! I get the
temptation to destroy things,
but can't we at least examine
it first?
Oh, is that ring glowing?
Whoa! It's blinding!
Ugh, my eyes are swimming.\nNow, where on earth are we?
C-Captain!
This place makes no sense! My\nscans aren't working! And I\ncan't see the ship anywhere!
This is clearly an artificial\nplace. It looks more like ruins\nthan a town.

There are gears moving
everywhere... Well, it's all junk,
but the technical skill is quite
impressive!
Wh-who are you people!? I\nwon't forgive you if you're here\nto ruin my date with Leenbell!
G-ghosts! Help me, Captain!!
Cardinal Peter, please step\nback! Fighting is my job.
I even put guards at the\nentrance... Where on earth did\nyou come from?
Even if you ask where... well.\nCaptain, can you explain?
...It seems there's more to this\nthan meets the eye. Let's have\na little chat.
...Hmph, so this little mushroom\nboy is the leader who rules this\nregion.
M-m-m-mushroom...
You're here as my escort for\nan "inspection" today, right,\nCardinal Peter?
Y-y-yes! That is correct!
My, my~? You seem awfully\nnervous... maybe your throat is\na bit dry?
Here, have this. It's a special,\ndelicious juice! Go on, drink up.
Oh, may I really drink it?
*Gulp gulp gulp*... Phew, it's\ndelicious...
*Poof!*
C-Cardinal Peter... he's become\na giant!?
Hey! Welch, what did you do?

Oh no! I can't believe I did this!
I gave him a prototype potion
called "Mad Bull" by mistake,
thinking it was juice!
Yikes! He's coming this way!\nEve, run!
Kuh-haaa!! I'm going to protect\nMiss Leenbell!

He's grown huge and he's
completely out of control!
Seriously, you did this on
purpose, didn't you?!
Cardinal Peter! Answer me!
...It's no use, he's not listening.\nCan't we change him back?!
Hehe... I figured something like\nthis might happen, so I've got a\nspecial Item ready for you too!
Here, come over here for a\nsecond!
Nuoh! Where are we going?!
What are you doing behind\ncover... why are you touching\nmy clothes... wait, whaa?!
Eve, help me out! And Captain,\nyou are absolutely NOT allowed\nto peek!
What on earth is with this\noutfit?!

A reinforced suit made by
Welch Lab! With this, we'll fight
and put that mushroom boy in
his place, and everything will
be solved!
Muhohohooo! Miss Leenbell!\nLove meeee!!
If it's come to this, we have no\nchoice. Peter! I'm coming to\nsave you!
Fushurururu~
Cardinal Peter, hang in there!
Munya munya... Good morning~.
Thank goodness... Your size is\nback to normal too.
Heh, I've always been a big\nman, Cardinal Peter...
Nu! Hawawawa... Miss Leenbell,\nthat dress! Oh my! Augh!

Hmm, I didn't expect him to
grow giant. I suppose applying
the Lycanthrope
transformation mechanism to a
Human is dangerous...
Hey, Welch... what were you\nthinking, giving people\nsuspicious medicine!?
Hey, it's not suspicious! I even\ntook a sip myself to test it.
I wonder if Mushroom Boy is\nsturdy enough to handle it all\nat once... just kidding.
I told you, it wasn't on purpose!
I-I-I'm so sorry!
If you're going to apologize, it\nshould be to Peter and\nLeenbell, not me.
I am truly sorry! To make it up\nto you, I'll just give you the\npower suit as a present!
Huh... oh... yes!
I'm so grateful!!! This is like a\ndream... like an angel...!!
(He's actually thrilled...)
(Even though he's the one who\ngot the worst of it.)
Eh? Did you hear something\njust now?
(Crap!)
(Idiot, hide!)

Coro: ...Miss Leenbell and I will
continue our... inspection a bit
longer. Please be careful,
everyone.
Welch: Now, let's head back to\nthe ship... wait, huh? H-how are\nwe supposed to get back!?
Welch: Coro, can't you do\nsomething? Like, just teleport\nus back instantly...
Coro: I-I don't have such a\nconvenient function!
Welch: You mean we have to\nspend the rest of our lives in a\nworld we don't know!?
Welch: No way... I'm not even\nmarried yet! Father, I'm so\nsorr-y...
Basel: Welch, calm down.\nMaybe that ring is the key?
Coro: Th-that's!? That's my\n"Zenith Star"!
Welch: This belongs to you,\nMushroom Boy?

Basel: That stone is a unique
item belonging to Cardinal
Peter. ...How did you come to
have it?

Coro: It's a very, very precious
treasure to me and everyone in
Basel! ...You'll give it back,
right?
Welch: Of course! I'm just glad\nwe found the owner.
Huh? The ring is glowing...
Whoa! It's blinding!
Wh-what's happening-shuu!?
...Wait? Are we back on our\nship...?
Phew... I have no idea how it\nworks, but we've returned\nsafely, Captain.
Hehehe...
I got the treasure-shuu!!
Why do you have it, Welch!? I\ndefinitely gave it to Peter...
While everyone was fighting, I\nswapped it for a\nsuper-exquisite replica I made!
Honestly, you're just too sly...
...The ring left a clear mark on\nyour finger, so I knew right\naway you were the owner.
This looks fragile, and it would\nbe a shame if Mushroom Boy's\nprecious treasure broke, right?

The ones I made are so tough,
you could punch someone while
wearing the rings and be just
fine!
Ugh. I just got a sudden chill...
This concludes the story of\nEnd of Eternity.

look forward to other upcoming
